## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the trigger, and the behavior after this change.
Link the relevant public issue or design discussion.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Explain unrun checks and meaningful
limitations. Include regression evidence for changed behavior.

## Compatibility and operation

Describe any public API, bundle ABI, asset, telemetry, native build, database,
configuration, or deployment changes. Link updated documentation where relevant.
If none apply, say so.

## Contribution

Confirm that your commits carry DCO sign-offs and the change preserves licensing
and attribution. Review staged content for local data, credentials, generated
artifacts, and Beads records before submitting.
